island605_summary.bp_rank61_explanation: BP rank #61 (bp_060_E2_gen16_g16_r2__81f696a2.py) computes a cosine kernel using n = len(bins) over the feasible-bins array; recomputed value is 0.028071 vs archived 0.02767 (abs_diff=0.000401). While source code confirms len(bins) dependence, the exact step triggering the divergence from the archived June runtime remains open.
island605_summary.protocol_boundary_note: Legacy June island605 OBP protocol passes all feasible bins including unopened capacity-100 bins (allowing active new-bin opening), whereas unified workbench OBP protocol scores only feasible open bins and opens a fresh bin only when no open bin fits.

heuragenix_petal_audit.actual_behavior: On symmetric distance matrices polar_angle evaluates atan2(d[0,i], d[i,0]) == pi/4 for every non-coincident customer, leaving customer order unchanged and performing single-customer first-fit append-to-end insertion.
